title: nodejs/node 2021-10-26, Version 16.13.0 'Gallium' (LTS), @richardlau
summary:
Notable Changes
This release marks the transition of Node.js 16.x into Long Term Support (LTS)
with the codename 'Gallium'. The 16.x release line now moves into "Active LTS"
and will remain so until October 2022. After that time, it will move into
"Maintenance" until end of life in April 2024.

title: oven-sh/bun Bun v0.0.41
summary:
To upgrade:
bash
bun upgrade
What's new:
bun run:
bun run ./file.js now supports running JavaScript, TS, TSX, and JSX files using Bun.js. If you pass bun run a filepath to a .js, .jsx, .tsx, or .ts file, it will run it with Bun.js instead of saying "error: Missing script". This is very experimental!
